newsitem.title: USA: American Industries ups Sirena stake.
newsitem.headline: American Industries ups Sirena stake.

text.p: American Industries Inc said on Monday it agreed to increase its stake in Sirena Apparel Group Inc to 32.4 percent from nine percent, adding 1.1 million shares to the 412,000 it already owns.
Terms of the purchase were undisclosed. Privately held American Industries is acquiring the shares, representing about 24 percent of the total outstanding, from Signal Capital Corp.
The deal, which is expected to close by the end of May, would make American Industries the largest single Sirena shareholder, the company said.

Sirena makes swimwear. Its chief executive, Douglas Arbetman, said in a statement that Sirena welcomes the additional investment by American Industries as a vote of confidence in the company's future.
Sirena shares closed Friday at 3-1/4. Their 52-week high was 4-7/8.
